asset: Red grained leather with a blind-debossed VERSED (designer photo, 2026-11-13), recoloured bottle green
author: supplied by the designer in chat
note: source_photo.png is the leather photo as sent (736 x 1308); green_reference.png the green envelope photo sent with it (colour target only). Maps use rows 0-560 of the photo, above the VERSED stamp. Relief = linear luminance divided by a ~60 px blur (lighting removed), mirrored 2 x 2 to 1472 x 1120. Colour = relief times the envelope green, sRGB #24503F (linear 0.0176, 0.0802, 0.0497; sampled from the lit envelope flap, about #2A5843 to #193A2F), mean checked; _glb.jpg the same as JPEG q90 4:4:4. Height = relief softened 1 px, stretched 0.5-99.5 percentile. green_leather_normal_gl.png: OpenGL normal from the height at 35 % of the 0.1 mm render relief. Scale assumed: the photo spans 150 mm, so the tile is 300 mm wide. dark_green_leather_color.png (+ _glb.jpg, q90 4:4:4; Medallion v007): the same relief at half contrast times a darker bottle green, sRGB #163E30 (linear 0.0080, 0.0482, 0.0296). green_leather_normal_soft_gl.png: the same height at 12 % of the 0.1 mm relief (a thinner grain for the GLB).
